description: Run bookkeeping for the full-corpus production run (Appendix 3), distilled from the per-decision output files of the research archive. One record per decision.

model.source: docker-compose.yaml of the model server and scripts/run_production_qwen.py in the research archive

main.fc_prefilter: original (RPD | RAD | Refugee Protection Division | Refugee Appeal Division)

supplementary.fc_prefilter: widened (adds Immigration and Refugee Board); FC decisions passing the widened filter but not the original one

fields.finish_reason: the API finish reason of the answering call
fields.text_truncated_to: characters kept when the decision text exceeded the context window; present only on the truncated decision
fields.text_chars: length of the decision text in characters; present only on the truncated decision

run_config.source: scripts/run_production_qwen.py in the research archive (--concurrency default 128)
